anatomy.evidence: All6 final native frames inspected. Near leg leads and supports1/2/3, far leg leads and supports4/5/6. Initial frame4 overlap and frame6 arm swing/support contact corrected through imagegen. Connected hips, knees, ankles, elbows and wrists; proportions remain consistent.

equipment.evidence: Stationary console, upright and lower base copied from exercise master using the previously authorized equipment method. Regions exclude athlete pixels. Full machine visible in every pose.

contact.evidence: Each pose visibly retains at least one supporting foot on the belt. Supporting feet travel backward while the opposite foot swings forward. Fixed rear support and front support edges and complete horizontal widths measured identically across all6; moving shoe coordinates are deliberately not treated as fixed anchors.

physics.evidence: Inclined walking variation supported by catalogue; front of deck raised, slight ankle lean and no waist fold. The projected deck slope is illustrative, not a calibrated real-world grade. Alternating heel contact, loading and swing; one foot remains on the belt, arms counter-swing, hands remain free of rails. Frame6 leads to next near heel contact. Illustrative six-pose cycle, not a calibrated gait simulation.

muscles.evidence: Glutes and calves strong purple; quads and hamstrings pale lilac, matching the existing incline treadmill rig.

cueAgreement.evidence: Six cues of at most seven words describe hands-free uphill stepping, weight transfer, opposite swing, soft landing with ankle lean, counter-swinging arms and an even stride.
